title: I Gave AI One Day to Build This Interactive Visual Page
author: Funny-Inflation-8142
selftext:
Try it here (desktop browser recommended):
    https://book.novusrelay.com
    
    I wanted to see what AI could build in a single day.
    
    I mainly set the direction, picked what felt right, and corrected it whenever it drifted. The visuals, animation, music, writing, and code were all produced by AI.
    
    This is the result: A Letter in the Landscape, a small interactive visual page with six dreamlike worlds.
    
    There’s nothing to win or complete.
    You can just walk around, sit down, listen to the wind, and stay for a while.
    
    I’m still experimenting with this way of creating, but I liked where this one ended up.
